column2: Children's book illustration: a small red fox reading a book under a large oak tree at dusk, fireflies around, soft and warm. No text or letters anywhere in the image.
Blog header illustration for an article about remote work: a person working on a laptop at a home desk with plants and a window, calm mood, space on the left for a headline. No text in the image.

Isometric illustration of a small cosy corner coffee shop exterior with outdoor seating and a bicycle parked outside, morning light. The shop sign must be blank: no letters, words or numbers anywhere.
Magazine spot illustration on the theme of saving money: a piggy bank growing a small plant from its back, limited 3-colour palette, plain light background. No text or numbers.
